title: DuTri: Dual-Branch Modeling with Triadic Factorization for Multimodal Multi-Scenario Recommendation
abstract: arXiv:2610.36836v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: As recommendation scenarios become increasingly diverse and multimodal information grows more prevalent, effectively modeling cross-scenario user preferences and multimodal semantics has become a critical challenge in recommender systems. When incorporating multimodal information, existing multi-scenario recommendation (MSR) methods typically treat textual and visual representations as generic input features and directly feed them into their original parameter-sharing architectures. However, this extension may not fully accommodate the different modeling requirements of collaborative and multimodal information and may not be the best modeling paradigm. Our controlled experiments show that directly adopting these architectures is not the optimal modeling approach. translated_title: DuTri：面向多模态多场景推荐的双分支建模与三元分解方法
translated_abstract: 随着推荐场景日益多样化、多模态信息愈发普及，如何有效建模跨场景的用户偏好与多模态语义已成为推荐系统中的关键挑战。在引入多模态信息时，现有多场景推荐（MSR）方法通常将文本和视觉表示当作通用的输入特征，直接送入其原有的参数共享架构中。然而，这种扩展方式可能无法充分满足协同信息与多模态信息各自不同的建模需求，也未必是最佳的建模范式。我们的对照实验表明，直接采用这些架构并非最优的建模方式。为此，我们提出了双分支建模与三元分解方法DuTri，这是一个面向多模态多场景推荐的框架，由一个协同分支和一个……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出DuTri框架，通过协同分支与多模态分支的双分支建模结合三元分解，分别满足协同信息与多模态信息的不同建模需求，从而实现更优的多模态多场景推荐效果。
en_tdlr: DuTri introduces a dual-branch modeling framework with triadic factorization that separately addresses the distinct modeling requirements of collaborative and multimodal information, achieving superior multimodal multi-scenario recommendation performance.
